review: Love the sleek design and the screen is bright even in direct sunlight.
Step tracking is accurate and setup took five minutes. Great value for the price.
Battery easily lasts a week. Very happy with this watch.
The companion app is clean and easy to use. Sleep tracking is surprisingly good.
Comfortable strap, I forget I'm wearing it. Heart rate readings match my chest strap.
Good watch overall, but the GPS takes forever to lock on before a run.
Syncing with the app fails about half the time and I have to restart my phone.
Fantastic features for the price, though notifications are sometimes delayed.
Customer support took 9 days to answer a simple warranty question.
After the latest firmware update the battery barely lasts two days. Very disappointing.
Oh great, another update that drains the battery. Exactly what I wanted, thanks so much.
The app keeps logging me out and my workout history disappeared once. Frustrating.
Screen cracked after a minor bump. Feels flimsy compared to my old watch.
Battery life dropped to a day and a half. I charge it every night now.
GPS accuracy is poor, my running route shows me crossing a lake.
Love the design, but the syncing problems make the smart features useless.
Support finally replied but the replacement process was confusing and slow.
No third-party app integrations such as Strava or Apple Health is a dealbreaker for me.
Battery life is terrible since July. Considering returning it.
The sleep and stress insights are useful and the interface is intuitive.
Wish it supported offline music and contactless payments like competitors do.
Sync is still unreliable and notifications arrive 10 minutes late.
Not bad for the price. Does what it says, nothing special.
Battery drain after the update is unacceptable. Fix it or I'm switching brands.
